included: one serial Qwen2.5 layer-0 token engine in RTL simulation
two authenticated Hello world embedding rows at positions 0 and 1 in cache slot 0
native asymmetric AWQ W4A16 projection pull interfaces
FP16 post-projection Q/K/V bias, Qwen2 RoPE, retained FP16 K/V cache, 14:2 GQA attention, MLP, residuals, and trace comparison
excluded: full model or all 24 decoder layers
dialogue, generation quality, tokenizer execution beyond the fixed authenticated IDs
synthesis, timing, power, area, PPA, FPGA, or silicon claims
automatic DMA, SRAM implementation, and tensor transport architecture

record_fields.token_ordinal: vector-file field for disambiguating the two sequential starts

trace.emission_order: The expected stream follows the token-engine state machine: norm1, Q, rotated Q in Qwen half-split pair order (p then p+32), K, V, rotated K in the same half-split pair order, alternating cache K/V writes, then per query-head score rows, probability rows, value dimensions, O, residual1, norm2, gate, up, SiLU, down, and final residual.

numerical_order.projection: native AWQ G128 group accumulators sum in signed Q53.48; every complete projection is rounded once to binary16
numerical_order.bias: Q, K, and V each add their FP16 checkpoint bias only after that complete projection rounding
numerical_order.rope: Qwen2 half-split RoPE uses binary16 multiply/multiply/add
numerical_order.attention: causal 14:2 GQA uses the accepted fixed-point score, softmax, and value operators over retained FP16 cache rows
numerical_order.mlp: rational integer SiLU gate uses the accepted adaptation oracle

oracle_integer_safety.host_representation: Python arbitrary-precision integers are used for all fixed-point products and sums; no host fixed-width integer can overflow.
oracle_integer_safety.projection_check: The composed projection oracle checks every G128 signed Q47.48 group and every signed Q53.48 complete sum against its contract width before binary16 rounding.
oracle_integer_safety.adaptation_check: RMSNorm, residual, SiLU, and attention use exact integer intermediate arithmetic from their independent existing oracles.
